Rural Prosperous (A1) tier - landowners, estate directors, affluent retirees. Rural has no S/A2/B1/C2/E1/E2/F2/UNI zone-types per Community_matrix, so only A1/C1/D1/D2/F1 are populated.
Rural New-Build Family (C1) tier - commuter-belt dual-income households, car-dependent per OAC rural pen portrait.
Rural Mixed (D1) tier - estate workers and self-employed rural trades, OAC Rural & Outlying Areas.
Rural Agricultural (D2) tier - farm and land-management labour, owner-occupied but rural hidden poverty per IMD.
Rural Deprived (F1) tier - post-industrial rural hardship (Welsh valleys / Durham pit village style), employment + health deprivation.
Suburb Prosperous (A1) tier - OAC Retired Professionals, high asset ownership. Suburb has no S/A2/D1/D2/E1/F2/TECH/GAME zone-types per Community_matrix.
Suburb Academic (B1) tier - university-adjacent professional suburb, elevated civic/political engagement.
Suburb Professional/Middle Class (C1+C2) tier - established owner-occupier suburban belt, dual income new-build estates.
Suburb Grassroots (E2) tier - suburban trade and self-employment zone, skilled trade NS-SEC L8-L11 elevated.
Suburb Deprived (F1) tier - pockets of suburban deprivation, smallest tier in the Region per Community_matrix.
Town Professional (C1) tier - market-town professional base, teachers/nurses/council anchored, ASG AB above national average.
Town Middle Class (C2) tier - coastal/market-town retirees and working-age service economy support.
Town Mixed New Town (B2) tier - planned mixed-income new town, balanced NS-SEC spread by design.
Town Working-Class (D2) tier - manufacturing/trade original base of the market town.
Town Deprived (F1) tier - coastal-town style deprivation, IMD 2025 coastal towns among most deprived LSOAs.

Birmingham-style affluent inner core - no Prestige(S) zone-type exists in Lowland per Community_matrix, so peak is A1 not S, and far less concentrated than Capital's Posh (A1=31 vs 41 in source Prosperous/A1 row).
Academic/professional inner zone - Lowland Academic/B1 source row peaks at only 28% (vs Capital's 50%), reflecting a much less specialised professional-elite cluster.
Established C1/C2 inner belt, broader and flatter than Capital's equivalent.
D1-anchored but flatter than Capital - Lowland Stable Family/D1 source row peaks at 46% vs Capital's 58%, so spread is wider across other codes.
Artistic E1-led zone with elevated C/D support, toned down from Capital's peak per general Lowland flattening.
E2-led creative-fringe poverty zone - Lowland Grassroots/E2 source row shows E1=46% (even higher than Capital's 41%), so E1 crossover is boosted here.
D2/E2 co-dominant working zone, F1 crossover boosted vs Capital reflecting Lowland's generally higher deprivation-adjacent baseline.
F1-dominant deprived inner zone, F2 crossover raised - Lowland deprivation rows consistently carry more F2 (Locals) than Capital's.
F2-dominant post-war estate zone with a heavier F1 tail than Capital - Lowland Social Estate/F2 source row hits F1=64% (vs Capital's 45-61%).
Campus-anchored UNI zone, same structure as Capital's tier.
Outer academic/professional zone, flattened to match Lowland Outer Academic/B1 source row (B1=28%, vs Capital's 46%).
Outer C1/C2 middle-class belt, broader spread than Capital equivalent.
D1-anchored but flatter - Lowland Outer Stable Family/D1 source row peaks at 44% vs Capital's varies, with wider secondary spread.
Outer artistic E1-led zone with C/D support.
Outer E2-led creative-fringe poverty zone, E1 crossover boosted per Lowland Outer Grassroots/E2 source row (E1=44%).
Outer D2/E2 co-dominant working zone.
Outer F1-dominant zone, F2 crossover raised vs Capital.
Outer F2-dominant estate zone with heavy F1 tail - Lowland Outer Social Estate/F2 source row hits F1=61%.
Outer campus-anchored UNI zone.

Rural top tier, sharply toned down from Capital - Lowland Rural Prosperous/A1 source row peaks at only 16% (vs Capital's 17-41 range across regions), so no landed-gentry-scale concentration exists here. Only A1/C1/D1/D2/F1 zone-types exist in Rural per Community_matrix.
Rural commuter-belt tier, C1-dominant.
Rural estate-worker/mixed tier, D1-dominant.
Rural farm-labour tier, D2-dominant, F1 raised vs Capital reflecting rural hidden poverty pattern in Lowland source rows.

Rural bottom tier - deliberately pushed harder than Capital's equivalent to reflect the East-UK-style rural deprivation pattern: Lowland Rural Deprived/F1 source row already hits F2=47% and F1=32%, well above Capital's F2=32%/F1=32%.

Suburb top tier, toned down - Lowland Suburb Prosperous/A1 source row peaks at only 20% (vs Capital's 20-55 range), so far less concentrated than Capital's Affluent tier. Only A1/B1/C1/C2/E2/F1 zone-types exist in Suburb per Community_matrix (UNI dropped as off-axis specialty, matching Capital convention).
Suburb academic tier, flattened - Lowland Suburb Academic/B1 source row peaks at 28% (vs Capital's 55%).
Suburb C1/C2 middle-class tier.
Suburb E2-dominant trade/self-employment tier.
Suburb bottom tier, F1-dominant.

Town top tier, C1-dominant but flatter than Capital - Lowland Town Professional/C1 source row peaks at 20% (vs Capital's 18). Only B2/C1/C2/D2/F1 zone-types used (E1 Mixed Rural Town dropped as off-axis specialty, matching Capital convention).
Town C2-dominant middle tier.
Town balanced/planned tier, B2-anchored, slightly flatter than Capital's Average.
Town D2-dominant working tier.
Town bottom tier, F1-dominant - kept strongly deprived per the East-UK coastal/market-town deprivation pattern (Lowland Town Deprived/F1 source row F1=46%, F2=25%).
